Market today: Inflation is the bogeyman, with consumer prices up more than expected. This complicates the Fed's job and usually spooks tech/chip names like yours.

Your holdings: SMCI (-34.66%), SOXL (-73.75%), MU (-57.6%), PLTU (-24.82%), SPAL (-42.03%), SMH (-22.87%), and METU (-12.91%) are all marked SELL and are deep in the red. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are getting hammered. QQQI (-8.93%) and QQQ (-4.98%) are also down, but less so. CRWD (+30.86%) is your only real winner.

Watch: The inflation data and any chatter from the Fed. Also, keep an eye on Jensen Huang's situation with Nvidia.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is facing serious headwinds from inflation and sector-specific issues.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's a SELL and down significantly. Consider cutting losses if it breaks below its stop.
Trim SOXL: Deeply negative and leveraged. Consider reducing exposure if it doesn't show immediate strength.
No new buys today - hold and watch
